test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This day next year / I will having a conference with / the international board / discussing the environment.

options.text: I will having a conference with

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The segment that contains a grammatical error is **"I will having a conference with".**
